## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Code refactoring (no functional changes)

## PR Checklist

Please check that you have completed the following:

- [ ] If you have added a new function, have you:
  - [ ] Added Roxygen-style documentation?
  - [ ] Added unit tests?
  - [ ] Run `devtools::check()` and fixed any errors?
  - [ ] Updated the vignettes (if necessary)?
  - [ ] Updated NEWS.md
  - [ ] Updated the package version using `usethis::use_version()`? Please follow the [semantic versioning guidelines](https://r-pkgs.org/lifecycle.html#sec-lifecycle-version-number-tidyverse).
- [ ] If this is fixing an issue, have you remembered to reference the issue in this PR and add `Closes #XXX`?
- [ ] Code follows the project's coding standards
- [ ] Self-review of code completed
- [ ] Tests pass locally with my changes
